text:
Mira: Heads-up — we're running an afternoon high-mem inference sweep for the new retrieval model. Need ~6x A100-80GB (120GB effective w/ NVLink) for ~3 hours starting 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Can we get a temporary quota top-up on the us-west2 project? Procurement PO-4872 filed. Terraform PR attached: https://git.company/repo/pull/489 — would love a quick status so I can schedule the runs.

vendor_ops_bot: Quick systems check: us-west2 currently shows 4x A100-80GB free, 2x pending allocation to another tenant. We can reassign 2 units by 22:30 UTC and 6 total by ~23:15 UTC if billing hold is cleared. Note: RDMA-backed racks limited.

Raj: Do we *require* RDMA for the sweep? The image expects CUDA 12.1 + NCCL 2.18. If vendor gives non-RDMA nodes we'll fall back to NCCL over TCP (slower). I can bake an image if slots are confirmed.

Oliver: I can kick off a 1-node canary right away to verify image + infra. Please approve PR https://git.company/repo/pull/490 — it tags reservations with `team=redwood-inference` and adds `max_replicas = 6` to the autoscaler.

Mira: Thanks — Raj, can you paste the exact image tag? @Luca can you check / lift the billing hold on PO-4872? We need at least 2 nodes allocated before 21:30 UTC to warm caches.

Luca: Oncall Luca: lifted the billing hold a few minutes ago, finance acknowledged. VendorPortal ticket VP-1129 updated. I've placed an immediate soft-reservation for 2 nodes and a soft-hold for 3 more (expiry 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC). When creating instances, use label `reserve:po-4872`. :thumbsup:

Raj: Image tag: `gcr.io/redwood/hi-retrieval:2026-03-30-rc2`. Start command: `./start.sh --enable-rdma` (if RDMA available) or `./start.sh --no-nvlink` for TCP fallback.

Oliver: Canary logs (just now): `ERROR: nvlink not found` on one attempt — retrying with `--no-nvlink` fixed it. I'll keep monitoring the canary run and update in ~15m.

vendor_ops_bot: Reservation confirmed. ID: R-7821. Allocated: 2 immediate, 3 soft-hold (release at 2026-04-03T02:00:00Z). Full 6 availability ETA dependent on incoming decommissions (~23:15 UTC).

Mira: Perfect — kicking off the sweep when Oliver gives green. If we need >6 later we'll re-open PO or escalate to vendor. I'll post results to #eng-runtime and add a short postmortem if we see perf regression.

Oliver: Green in 5. Starting canary now. Will ping on failures.

Raj: I'll stand by to bake another image if we hit NCCL regressions.

Luca: If anyone needs me to extend soft-hold, shout here — I can push the expiry out another 4h from now if finance signs off.

Mira: Thanks all. :rocket:
